title: Adroit Industries (India) IPO Details
intro:
Adroit Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹150.71 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 98.97 lakh shares aggregating to ₹132.62 crores and offer for sale of 13.50 lakh shares aggregating to ₹18.09 crores.

Adroit Industries IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and will close on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Adroit Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Adroit Industries IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Adroit Industries IPO is set final issue price at ₹134 per share. The lot size for an application is 111 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,874 (111 shares) (based on upper price).

Choice Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Adroit Industries IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in January 1995, Adroit Industries (India) Limited is a vertically integrated manufacturer and supplier of propeller shafts and torque-transmission components used in driveline systems. The Company offers a portfolio of over 5,000 SKUs comprising precision-machined torque-transmission components, complete propeller shaft assemblies and forged components. Its vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities cover forging, precision machining, heat treatment, assembly, balancing and testing, enabling end-to-end control over the production process.

The Company supplies its products through distributors, Tier-1 driveline component suppliers and directly to OEMs, based on customer-specific technical requirements. Its products cater primarily to commercial vehicles, as well as SUVs, defence and emergency services, heavy equipment, off-highway machinery and industrial applications.

The Company has a strong export presence, supplying products to customers across North America, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific. During Fiscal 2026, it supplied products to customers across more than 32 countries.
The Company is supported by its subsidiary, Adroit Driveshafts Private Limited, and together they had 367 permanent employees as of July 31, 2026.
strengths: Established customer relationships and repeat business.
about.text:
Incorporated in January 1995, Adroit Industries (India) Limited is a vertically integrated manufacturer and supplier of propeller shafts and torque-transmission components used in driveline systems. The Company offers a portfolio of over 5,000 SKUs comprising precision-machined torque-transmission components, complete propeller shaft assemblies and forged components. Its vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities cover forging, precision machining, heat treatment, assembly, balancing and testing, enabling end-to-end control over the production process.

The Company supplies its products through distributors, Tier-1 driveline component suppliers and directly to OEMs, based on customer-specific technical requirements. Its products cater primarily to commercial vehicles, as well as SUVs, defence and emergency services, heavy equipment, off-highway machinery and industrial applications.

The Company has a strong export presence, supplying products to customers across North America, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific. During Fiscal 2026, it supplied products to customers across more than 32 countries.

The Company is supported by its subsidiary, Adroit Driveshafts Private Limited, and together they had 367 permanent employees as of July 31, 2026.

objectives: 1 — Funding capital expenditure by the Company towards procurement of; (i) machinery and equipment for enhancement of operations at Dewas Facility; and (ii) transportation vehicle for local transportation of goods between the Manufacturing Facilities

2 — Investment in the Subsidiary, Adroit Driveshafts Private Limited, in the form of debt or equity or a combination thereof, for funding capital expenditure towards procurement of; (i) machinery and equipment for enhancement of operations at Pithampur Facility; and (ii) transportation vehicle for local transportation of goods between the Manufacturing Facilities

3 — Investment in the Subsidiary, Adroit Driveshafts Private Limited, in the form of debt or equity or a combination thereof, for re-payment or pre-payment, in full or in part, of certain borrowings availed by the Subsidiary

faqs.question: How to apply in Adroit Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Adroit Industries IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Adroit Industries IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Adroit Industries IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Adroit Industries IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Adroit Industries IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Adroit Industries IPO opens on Wed, Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Fri, Sep 25, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Adroit Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: Adroit Industries IPO lot size is 111 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,874 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Adroit Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Adroit Industries IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Adroit Industries IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Adroit Industries IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026 . Check the Adroit Industries IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Adroit Industries IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Adroit Industries IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 30, 2026 .
